original_value: Boost your PC storage with WD Blue drives, the brand designed just for desktop and all-in-one PCs. The WD Blue family now delivers data storage capacities up to 6 TB.

result.paraphrase: Expand your PC storage with WD Blue drives, a brand built specifically for desktop and all-in-one PCs. The WD Blue family now offers data storage capacities of up to 6 TB.
